XY series · PHF

Phantom Forces

Released November 5, 2014 · 124 cards

Expanded

Phantom Forces is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the XY series, released in English on November 5, 2014. Its main set has 119 cards, plus 5 secret rares numbered beyond the set (124 in total). It includes 99 Pokémon, 23 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

36 illustrators worked on Phantom Forces. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (22), Ryo Ueda (8), Toyste Beach (6), Sanosuke Sakuma (5), Eske Yoshinob (4), Kagemaru Himeno (4), Kouki Saitou (4), match (4).
